# Launch post drafts

Ground rules: say what it is and is not, link the repo and the latest release, answer every comment, never ask for stars.

## Show HN

**Title:** Show HN: Stormcoder – desktop AI coding agent that runs on your own keys or local models

**Body:**
I wanted an AI coding agent that is not tied to one vendor or a subscription, so I built a standalone Electron app around a multi-provider chat engine.

- Bring OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral and more, or point it at Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM. When one account hits its limit it falls back to your next credential.
- Ask, Plan and Agent modes. The agent has file, search, shell and fetch tools, sub-agents, a todo list it must finish, and an Undo for every run.
- Guardrails (protected paths, denied commands, workspace confinement) are enforced in code, not by the prompt.
- MCP servers, skills, rules, and memory between chats. Optional phone pairing with end-to-end encrypted approvals.
- Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux. MIT licensed.

Repo: https://github.com/techgniouss/Stormcoder
Feedback on provider coverage and the agent's safety model is very welcome.
